title: RAG with Microsoft.Extensions.AI
description: Use Microsoft.Extensions.AI abstractions to build provider-agnostic RAG pipelines in C#.

blocks.text: Microsoft.Extensions.AI provides common interfaces for embeddings and LLMs. This keeps your RAG code portable across OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Ollama, and future providers without rewriting orchestration logic.

blocks.title: Key interfaces
items: **IEmbeddingGenerator** — generates embeddings for one or more inputs.
**IChatClient** — sends chat completions with messages, tools, and system prompts.
**AIFunction** — describes a callable tool the model can request.
**Configuration** — binds providers from appsettings.json or environment variables.

blocks.title: End-to-end RAG with Microsoft.Extensions.AI
blocks.content: Complete RAG orchestration using provider-agnostic abstractions with sample data.

blocks.title: Prefer abstractions in new code
blocks.text: Direct HTTP clients are fine for exploration, but abstractions make testing and provider swaps easier in the long run.

blocks.title: Swap Providers
blocks.description: Implement the same RAG flow using two different providers.
steps: Build a minimal RAG endpoint with OpenAI embeddings and chat.
Switch the embedding and chat clients to Azure OpenAI using the same abstractions.
Verify behavior without changing orchestration code.
blocks.expectedOutcome: You should confirm that provider-agnostic abstractions let you change models without rewriting retrieval or prompt composition.
